simple.meaning: שָׂמֵחַ (sâmêach) is a Hebrew action word meaning “blithe or gleeful.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 20 times in Deuteronomy, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, and 5 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 16:15. The surrounding contexts include family line, kingship, priesthood, prophetic witness, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂמֵחַ (H8056) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׂמֵחַ (sâmêach) / H8056 is traced through Deuteronomy 16:15, 1 Kings 1:40, 1 Kings 1:45, 1 Kings 4:20 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H8056. sameach שָׂמֵחַ verbal adjective glad, joyful, merry ; — absolute ׳שׂ Deut 16:15 +, feminine שְׂמֵחָה Psa 119:9 ; plural שְׂמֵחִים 1Kin 1:45 +, construct שִׂמְחֵי Isa 24:17 , שְׂמֵחֵי Psa 35:26 ; — 1. a. as adjective joyful, shewing joy , 1Kin 1:45 ; Est 5:9 (+ לֵב טוֺב ), 5:14 ; שְׂמֵחָה אֵם Psa 113:9 ; שׂ ׳לֵב Prov 15:13 ; 17:22 ; at feast of tabernacle Deut 16:15 , in thankfulness to ׳י Psa 126:3 (both predicate with הָיָה ), 1Kin 8:66 (+ לֵב טוֺבֵי ) = 2Chr 7:10 . b. = participle 1Kin 1:40 (|| מְחַלְּלִים piping ), 4:20 ; 2Kin 11:14 (+ ב תֹּקֵעַ ) = 2Chr 23:13 , מִן of thing Eccl 2:10 . 2 as substantive ׳הַשׂ Amos 6:13 (+ ל of thing), Prov 2:14 ( ל infinitive), Job 3:22 (+ אֱלֵיגִֿיל ; || יָשְׂישׂוּ ); שִׂמְחֵילֵֿב Isa 24:7 ; of malicious joy ׳שׂ Prov 17:5 ( ל of thing), רָעָתִי שְׂמֵחֵי Psa 35:26 .
